research.name: Character Studio
research.note: Browser studio for assembling VRM avatars from swappable trait slots on a live three.js model, with glb and VRM export.

effects: point-and-click VRM avatar assembly from swappable trait slots on a live 3D model
per-trait culling layers with cull distance sliders that hide faces under clothing
